content: विचेष्टित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Striven, tried, struggled. .²2 Examined, investigated. .²3 Misdone, done foolishly. .{@-तम्@} .²1 An act, a deed; न हि मे शृण्वतस्तृप्तिरस्ति तेषां विचेष्टितम् <ls>Mb. 3. 160. 6</ls>. .²2 Effort, movement, undertaking, enterprise. .²3 Gesture. .²4 Working, sensation, play; किमपि चेदमनङ्गविचेष्टितम् <ls>V. 2. 9</ls>. .²5 Machination.
